name: Karthus
notes: Lay Waste's cooldown is read as the wiki's flat 1s at every rank (the bin lists 0, which looks like a data artifact); it always hits only the dummy so it always lands as the doubled, single-target 'Isolated Enhanced' damage.

Lay Waste's cast-to-detonation delay is assumed at 0.625s, the midpoint of the wiki's stated 0.5-0.75s range, since the source itself calls the exact figure inconsistent; the 0.25s cast still triggers the usual attack lockout at the moment of cast.

Defile is toggled on for the whole fight and ticks every 0.25s, matching the wiki's stated tick rate and the sheet's TotalDPS*0.25 per-tick formula; toggled abilities do not proc on-cast effects (Spellblade, Muramana), so only Q and R do.

Wall of Pain is cast at t=0 for its 25% magic resistance shred (declared under Q's ability block, the one slot the engine reads for a shred) and recast whenever its cooldown comes back up before the fight ends; its slow is ignored since the dummy is stationary and never needs re-hitting.

Requiem is cast at t=0 (bundled with the opening Defile toggle and Wall of Pain cast, treated as simultaneous); its 3s channel blocks Lay Waste until it completes but Defile keeps ticking through it, matching the wiki's note that Defile survives Karthus's zombie state.

Mana is modeled as a simple pool starting at the fight's sheet mana. Requiem, Wall of Pain and Lay Waste spend it on cast and Defile drains it every tick, in whatever order events occur; Lay Waste stops forever once the pool can't pay its cost, and Defile switches off for good the first time it can't pay a tick.
Death Defied is a defensive-only passive (untargetable zombie state triggered by Karthus's own death) and has no effect on a stationary dummy that never fights back, so it is omitted from the kit.
Karthus attacks normally between casts using the engine's default basic-attack handling; nothing in his kit modifies attacks, on-hit damage or attack speed.

assumed.why: cast-to-detonation delay stated only as an inconsistent 0.5-0.75s range; the midpoint is used
